title: Washington State Records First Bird Flu Death of the Year
subtitle: Health officials confirm a resident has died following exposure to infected dairy cattle, while stressing that the risk to the general public remains low.

summary.en: A resident of Yakima County, Washington, has died after contracting bird flu from infected dairy cattle. This is the first death linked to the virus in the United States during 2026. Health officials noted that the individual had underlying health conditions. While 33 dairy herds in the county have tested positive for the virus, officials say the risk to the public is low. Experts confirm that human-to-human spread of the virus has not been documented.
summary.zh: 華盛頓州雅基馬郡一名居民在感染來自受感染乳牛的禽流感後過世。這是二〇二六年美國首起與該病毒相關的死亡案例。衛生官員指出，該名患者本身患有潛在健康問題。儘管該郡已有三十三群乳牛對病毒檢測呈陽性，但官員表示對大眾的風險仍然很低。專家證實，目前尚未有病毒在人與人之間傳播的紀錄。

paragraphs.en: Health officials in Washington state reported on Sunday that a local resident has died after becoming ill with bird flu, also known as avian influenza. This death marks the first time a person has died from complications related to the virus in the United States this year. According to The Guardian Health, the individual was exposed to the virus at a dairy farm in Yakima County where cattle were infected. The person, who had underlying health conditions, was hospitalized before passing away.
paragraphs.zh: 華盛頓州的衛生官員於週日通報，當地一名居民在感染禽流感後不幸過世。這是今年美國首度出現與該病毒併發症相關的死亡案例。根據《衛報健康版》（The Guardian Health）報導，該名患者是在雅基馬郡（Yakima County）的一處乳牛場接觸到病毒，當時該場內的牛隻已受感染。該名患者本身患有潛在健康問題，在過世前曾住院治療。

paragraphs.en: This development comes during a time of increased concern in Yakima County. Since early October, officials have reported that 33 dairy herds have tested positive for a highly contagious version of the virus. The Yakima Health District, working alongside the Washington State Department of Health, is currently monitoring the situation. In addition to the recent death, the district confirmed a third human case of bird flu in the county. Officials stated that this third person was also exposed to infected dairy cattle but did not require hospitalization.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件發生之際，雅基馬郡正處於高度關注時期。自十月初以來，官員通報已有三十三群乳牛對該病毒的高傳染性變異株檢測呈陽性。雅基馬衛生局（Yakima Health District）正與華盛頓州衛生廳合作監控疫情。除了這起死亡案例外，該局也證實郡內出現了第三起人類感染禽流感的病例。官員表示，這第三名患者同樣是因為接觸受感染的乳牛而染病，但並未達到需要住院的程度。

paragraphs.en: MedPage Today reports that the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has recorded 72 human cases of bird flu across the United States since the beginning of 2024. Before this recent case, there had been two other deaths tied to the virus since it became a national public health concern. One death occurred in January 2025, and another happened in Washington state in November 2025. The CDC confirmed that the virus found in the most recent patient was the H5N1 version. After studying the virus, the agency noted that there were no genetic changes that would make it spread more easily or cause more severe illness in humans.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《MedPage Today》報導，美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）自二〇二四年年初以來，已記錄了七十二起人類感染禽流感的病例。在此次案例之前，自該病毒成為全國公共衛生隱憂以來，已有兩起與其相關的死亡案例。其中一起發生於二〇二五年一月，另一起則發生於二〇二五年十一月的華盛頓州。美國疾病管制與預防中心證實，在最新這名患者身上發現的病毒為 H5N1 型。該機構在研究病毒後指出，並未發現任何基因變異會導致病毒更容易在人類之間傳播，或引發更嚴重的疾病。

paragraphs.en: Despite these reports, health authorities continue to emphasize that the risk to the general public remains low. Officials explain that the virus is primarily a concern for those who work closely with animals. According to The Guardian Health, people at the greatest risk are dairy workers and others who have close or long-term contact with infected animals or environments where the virus is present. The CDC has maintained that human-to-human transmission of bird flu is extremely rare and has never been documented in the United States. There is currently no evidence that the virus is spreading between people.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這些報導，衛生當局仍持續強調，對一般大眾而言，風險依然偏低。官員解釋，該病毒主要對那些與動物密切接觸的工作人員構成威脅。根據《衛報健康版》報導，風險最高的人群為乳牛場員工，以及其他與受感染動物或病毒存在環境有密切或長期接觸的人員。美國疾病管制與預防中心堅持認為，禽流感在人與人之間的傳播極為罕見，且在美國從未有過相關紀錄。目前沒有證據顯示該病毒正在人際間傳播。

paragraphs.en: To manage the situation, local officials are working with public health partners to identify anyone who had close contact with the infected individuals. These people are being monitored for any signs of illness. Meanwhile, the Yakima Health District has expressed its condolences to the family and friends of the person who died. The district is continuing to coordinate with state health experts to track the virus and prevent further spread.
paragraphs.zh: 為了控制疫情，當地官員正與公共衛生夥伴合作，找出所有曾與感染者有過密切接觸的人員。這些人員目前正接受監控，以觀察是否有任何患病跡象。與此同時，雅基馬衛生局已向逝者的親友表達哀悼。該局正持續與州政府的衛生專家協調，以追蹤病毒並防止疫情進一步擴散。

paragraphs.en: Health experts are also reminding the public about safety precautions. MedPage Today reports that officials urge anyone who has contact with sick or dead birds to be very careful. This includes wearing gloves and protection for the eyes and breathing passages when handling poultry or working on farms. Because the virus has been spreading among wild birds, poultry, and livestock for several years, its presence in the environment means that the chance of human exposure exists. However, by following safety guidelines and limiting contact with infected animals, officials believe the risk can be managed effectively. As the investigation continues, health agencies remain focused on monitoring the dairy herds and supporting those who work in the agricultural industry.
paragraphs.zh: 衛生專家也提醒大眾應採取安全預防措施。《MedPage Today》報導指出，官員呼籲任何接觸過病鳥或死鳥的人員務必格外小心。這包括在處理家禽或在農場工作時，應配戴手套以及保護眼睛與呼吸道的裝備。由於該病毒已在野生鳥類、家禽與牲畜間傳播多年，其在環境中的存在意味著人類仍有接觸的風險。然而，官員認為，只要遵循安全準則並限制與受感染動物的接觸，風險是可以有效管理的。隨著調查持續進行，衛生機構仍將重點放在監控乳牛群，並為農業從業人員提供支援。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A polite or gentle way to say that someone has died.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是「die」的委婉說法，常被誤以為是單純的「經過」。文中：The person, who had underlying health conditions, was hospitalized before passing away.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Connected to or caused by something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指疾病與病毒之間的關聯，而非字面上的「綁在一起」。文中：Before this recent case, there had been two other deaths tied to the virus since it became a national public health concern.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To control or deal with a difficult situation or risk.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見意思為「設法做到」，這裡指對風險的控管。文中：However, by following safety guidelines and limiting contact with infected animals, officials believe the risk can be managed effectively.

previousArticles.title: Washington State Reports First Bird Flu Death of the Year
previousArticles.summaryEn: A resident of Yakima County, Washington, has died after contracting bird flu from infected dairy cattle. This marks the first death from the virus in the United States this year. Health officials confirmed that the person had existing health conditions that made them more vulnerable. While three human cases have been identified in the county, authorities stress that the virus does not spread easily between people. The public is advised to avoid contact with sick animals to prevent further infections.

quiz.question: What specifically distinguishes the recent death in Yakima County from the other human cases mentioned in the second paragraph?

options.A: The individual was the first person in the United States to contract the H5N1 virus this year.
options.B: The individual had pre-existing health issues that contributed to their hospitalization and death.
options.C: The individual was the only person in the county to have contact with infected dairy cattle.
options.D: The individual was the only patient among the three cases in the county who required medical treatment.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第一段結尾，該名死者擁有 underlying health conditions（潛在健康狀況），這是導致其住院並最終死亡的關鍵細節。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到這是該年度美國首例死亡，而非首例確診。選項 C 錯誤，因為第二段提到第三名病例也與受感染的乳牛有接觸。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章指出該名死者確實住院了，但並未說明其他病例是否完全不需要任何醫療介入，僅提到第三例不需要住院。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why are health officials currently monitoring individuals who had close contact with the infected patients?

options.A: To confirm if the virus has mutated into a form that spreads easily between humans.
options.B: To prevent the virus from spreading from humans to the local dairy cattle herds.
options.C: To identify potential new human cases early, despite the current lack of evidence for human-to-human transmission.
options.D: To provide medical treatment to these individuals before they develop any symptoms of the flu.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。雖然文章第四段提到人傳人極為罕見且尚未記錄，但第五段提到官員正在監控曾與患者密切接觸的人，這是一種預防性的公共衛生措施，目的是在潛在感染發生時能儘早發現。選項 A 與第三段提到的「病毒無基因變化」相矛盾。選項 B 顛倒了傳播方向，目前是動物傳人。選項 D 錯誤，因為監控的目的在於觀察症狀，而非在未發病前就進行治療。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what is the best meaning of the word 'maintained' in the sentence: 'The CDC has maintained that human-to-human transmission of bird flu is extremely rare'?

options.A: Repaired or kept in good condition.
options.B: Stated or asserted a position consistently.
options.C: Increased the frequency of a specific action.
options.D: Provided financial support for a study.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，maintain 作為動詞意指「堅持主張」或「堅稱」。CDC 一貫地表達其立場。選項 A 是常見的誤導，指維修或保養設備。選項 C 與 D 皆與該詞在學術或新聞報導中表達立場的用法不符。透過上下文可知，這是在陳述 CDC 對於病毒傳播方式的官方立場。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the current bird flu situation in Washington state?

options.A: The bird flu outbreak in Yakima County is spiraling out of control and poses an imminent threat to the general public.
options.B: Human-to-human transmission of the H5N1 virus has become a major concern for federal health agencies.
options.C: While the virus is present in animals and has caused a death, the risk to the general public remains low if safety guidelines are followed.
options.D: Dairy farm workers are no longer at risk because health officials have successfully contained the virus in cattle.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章整體架構先報導了死亡案例與疫情發展，隨後在第四段與第六段強調風險對大眾而言仍然很低，並提供具體的預防建議，總結了目前的公共衛生觀點。選項 A 過度誇大風險；選項 B 與第四段內容直接衝突；選項 D 錯誤，因為文章提到官員仍在監控牛群，並未宣稱病毒已被完全消滅或風險已消失。
